text: {"lessons":["Repeatedly selling Stock A at a gain felt good, but realized wins do not guarantee good overall decisions; assess each trade by its expected contribution to the portfolio.","After the account fell, I bought several stocks, but a recent decline is not evidence that prices will rebound; avoid buying just to make losses feel easier to recover.","I tend to judge each stock separately by its gain or loss since purchase. Keep that feeling from driving trades, and consider risk, diversification, and available cash across the whole account."]}
